title: Lab - Logging in and system documentation
description: Find your way around a fresh system using only its built-in help.
scenario: Find your way around a fresh system using only its built-in help. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Which section
tasks.instructions: Find which man page section documents the passwd file (not the command) and open it.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Search
tasks.instructions: Find every command related to "compress" without knowing their names.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Switch console
tasks.instructions: Switch to tty3, log in, and return to the graphical session.
